ui.click#0.notes: single sharp transient, audible 0.09 s, dry: reads as a crisp button click

ui.hover#0.notes: tiny transient with a short high ring (0.19 s audible); played 12 dB under the mix

hero.step#0.notes: near silence: peak -32 dBFS, RMS -48.5, only low noise, no footstep transient

hero.step#1.notes: crunch present but quieter and less defined than take 2 (peak -21 dBFS)

hero.step#2.notes: one clear high crunch over 0.25 s, peak -15.8 dBFS; quiet take lifted by the playback gain

pickup#0.notes: bright tonal chime with harmonics decaying over 0.8 s, clean onset

gold#0.notes: many small bright metallic transients over 0.9 s: coin jingle shape

build#0.notes: two hammer knocks 0.3 s apart and a ringing decay; punchy, reads as construction

recruit#0.notes: the boot stomp lands 0.95 s after the click and is cut off at the end: too slow and abrupt

recruit#1.notes: armor clank burst in the first 0.3 s then a clean decay; short and punchy

level-up#0.notes: stepped rising tonal notes in the first 0.6 s then a sustained shimmer: jingle shape

new-day#0.notes: soft tonal bell strikes, gentle level (RMS -18 dBFS), calm decay

new-week#0.notes: two brass-like harmonic notes then a held tail; short fanfare

battle.hit#0.notes: sharp broadband impact transient, audible 0.27 s, dry

battle.heavy-hit#0.notes: pulsing rumble fills the whole take, no single clean impact, cut at the end

battle.heavy-hit#1.notes: quiet (RMS -30 dBFS) with a long noisy rumble tail

battle.heavy-hit#2.notes: one deep low-frequency boom decaying over 0.44 s: heavy, clean, punchy

battle.shot#0.notes: high-frequency whoosh swelling to a peak at 0.25 s: arrow flight timed to the projectile

battle.death#0.notes: loud body at 0-0.35 s (groan and thud) then a short scattered tail

victory#0.notes: broadband orchestral swell for 1.1 s then a clean decay by 2.4 s

defeat#0.notes: low rolling timpani-like pulses for 2 s then a decay; somber, low register

spell.bloom#0.notes: rustling noise pulses with bright high sparkle over 1.1 s

spell.accord#0.notes: high tonal bell line with stamp-like transients; a little bell blip at 1.25 s

spell.clock#0.notes: regular ticking transients across 1.3 s: clockwork

spell.hush#0.notes: soft broadband breathy decay, no hard transient: airy whisper shape

spell.storm#0.notes: broadband crack with a long thunder-like decay
